controls.evidence: effective policy for the organization and user
controls.recovery: correct enterprise policy or organization assignment

controls.enforcementSurface: .github/copilot-instructions.md, path-scoped .github/instructions/*.instructions.md, and supported content exclusion in GitHub Copilot settings
controls.evidence: applicable repository guidance, path-scoped guidance, and excluded paths
controls.recovery: remove sensitive input and narrow the task context

controls.owner: enterprise AI administrator and repository owner
controls.enforcementSurface: Copilot > Policies > MCP plus managed allowedMcpServers and deniedMcpServers; .github/mcp.json declares repository servers
controls.evidence: effective allow or deny result and loaded MCP server tools
controls.recovery: select an approved server or request an enterprise allowlist change

controls.enforcementSurface: .github/hooks/governance.json invoking scripts/pre-tool-use.mjs for Copilot CLI PreToolUse
controls.evidence: structured allow, ask, or deny decision
controls.recovery: split the task or request the named human confirmation

controls.enforcementSurface: .github/workflows/change-evidence.yml published as the required change-evidence check
controls.evidence: test, lint, scan, and unresolved-finding results
controls.recovery: repair the change and rerun the failed check

controls.evidence: code-owner approval and satisfied merge requirements
controls.recovery: revise the change or use the documented bypass authority
